covers: Monday 9 November closes on the JSE and Wall Street, and the rand to early Tuesday. This edition is built from closing prices only; overnight news stories (including reports about Nvidia's chief executive and the oil-price fall) could not be opened and checked in time, so they are left out until verified.
headline: Breaking: AMD closes up 13.3% and Nvidia down 4.3% as the S&P 500 jumps 2.3%; Brent drops 6.7% to $91.71
summary: In South Africa the JSE All Share closed Monday at 115,037.93 (+2.0%) and the Top 40 at 107,087.60 (+2.3%), led by miners, and the rand was at R16.37/$ early Tuesday, about 0.6% firmer than Friday (Yahoo Finance, 9–10 Nov). On Wall Street the S&P 500 closed at 7,549.94 (+2.3%) and the Nasdaq at 25,253.14 (+2.7%), with AMD up 13.3% and Nvidia down 4.3%, while the US 10-year yield was 4.86% (Yahoo Finance, 9 Nov). Brent fell 6.7% to $91.71 while gold (+1.2% to $4,122.10), platinum (+2.4%) and copper (+2.3%) rose, which helps the fuel-price outlook and supports JSE miners ahead of US October CPI and SA Q3 jobs data today.

items.title: AMD closes +13.3% at $508.58; Nvidia closes -4.3% at $178.67
items.summary: AMD extended its intraday gain into the close on Monday 9 November, while Nvidia (HOLD) fell 4.3% and stays below its $191.50 breakdown level ahead of results on 17 November. The reasons behind Nvidia's fall could not be verified for this edition and are left out.
